import json  # added by the harness: the observations line is printed as JSON
import json
from rich.highlighter import ReprHighlighter
from rich.text import Text

def get_spans(s):
    h = ReprHighlighter()
    t = h(Text(s))  # hand-fix: read spans from the returned Text
    return [(span.start, span.end, span.style) for span in t.spans]

inputs = {
    "adjacent": "<a>content1</a><b>content2</b>",
    "single": "<a>content</a>",
    "preceded": "xx<a>content</a>yy",
    "followed": "<a>content</a>zz",
    "newline": "<a>content</a>\\nnext",
    "pre_newline": "before<a>content</a>\\nnext",
}
obs = {}
for k, inp in inputs.items():
    try:
        obs[f"c3.{k}"] = get_spans(inp)
    except Exception as e:
        obs[f"c3.{k}"] = {"exception": type(e).__name__}

print(json.dumps({"observations": obs}))
